name: 14760 · Olean, NY
findings: ZIP 14760 (Olean) has 111 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14760 (Olean) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
46% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14760 (Olean) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
